text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Canary pool us-west-2-wavelet showing 3x tail latency after rollout wavelet-1.4.3. Error budget burn high. Auto-escalate to oncall.

alice_oncall: grabbing it. seeing latency spike ~200ms -> 1.2s p95 on gen9-gpu nodes. Only canary slice, ~15% traffic.

ben_runtime: probable kernel fallback events during LRU eviction. Logs show repeated kernel selector fallback to generic matmul/attention kernels. batching window jittering too.

carol_sre: stack trace sample snippets: ```
2026-03-15T14:01:02Z runtime: kernel_selector: fallback to generic_kernel (reason=quant_mismatch)
2026-03-15T14:01:03Z batcher: window_size fluctuated 64->8->128 -> queue-depth spike
2026-03-15T14:01:03Z kvcache: miss-rate +14%
```

alice_oncall: hunch: release changed kernel hints (auto-quant config) and the canary traffic distribution exposed microbatch jitter. We should cut traffic and enable kill-switch for the new route.

ben_runtime: confirmed: release toggled `auto_quant_hints=true` in runtime config. On these older drivers it triggers fallback. Reverting that flag fixes kernel selection in local repro.

alice_oncall: action plan: 1) flip feature flag for wavelet route to fallback-to-stable (kill-switch). 2) divert canary traffic to stable pool. 3) start rollback if flip insufficient. 4) notify CS + impacted customers.

carol_sre: commands: ```sh
# flip kill-switch in control-plane
redwoodctl feature-flags set wavelet-route.use_stable_kernels=true --env=canary-us-west-2
# divert traffic back
redwoodctl routing set route wavelet-canary --traffic=0.0 --to=stable-us-west-2
```

dave_support: FYI customer ticket #CH-4421 (AcmeHealth) reporting slow responses in the last 20m. They sampled a 2.3s response that timed out their UI.

frank_csm: looped in AcmeHealth POC. Preparing a short customer notice once we have mitigation outcome. Prefer "we're rolling back a canary change to restore performance" messaging.

erin_product: please cc me on outbound. Also we need timeline for root cause and rollback ETA.

alice_oncall: starting actions now. flipping flag -> `OK` (control-plane ack). diverting traffic -> applying. monitoring. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

incident-bot: control-plane: feature-flag update accepted (tx=0x9f3a). routing change in progress.

ben_runtime: after flag flip, p95 dropped from 1.2s -> 380ms within 60s. queue depth stabilized. kernel fallback logs reduced significantly.

alice_oncall: great. holding for 10m to ensure stability. if stable -> no rollback, but block rolling-out wavelet-1.4.3 to remaining regions.

carol_sre: adding postmortem tag and linking runbook: https://confluence.internal/runbooks/runtime-kernel-fallback. Recommend follow-ups: tighten canary CPU/P95 SLOs, add explicit kernel-compat check to preflight.

dave_support: updating CH-4421: "We've mitigated the issue by reverting a canary kernel config; performance should be restored. We'll follow up once fully verified."

frank_csm: AcmeHealth acknowledged. they asked if any data was exposed — no error codes indicating data loss, just latency.

erin_product: ETA request from execs. can we estimate safe window to resume rollout?

ben_runtime: need a small patch to ensure auto_quant_hints opt-in only when kernels advertise quantized ops. I'll push a patch to canary branch and request QA for a targeted repro. ETA ~4h for a validated canary, longer to resume global rollout.

alice_oncall: status update: mitigation successful, canary traffic diverted, customer notified. Leaving incident open for postmortem and follow-up tasks. Oncall handoff to ben_runtime in 2h for verification during the rest of the rolling window.

carol_sre: tagging postmortem owners: ben_runtime (tech lead), erin_product (release owner), alice_oncall (incident owner).

incident-bot: INCIDENT: mitigated -> monitoring. Severity reduced to SEV3.

alice_oncall: closing the live mitigation phase. next steps: create postmortem, patch, QA, resume with tightened canary 1/10 traffic.

ben_runtime: copying final log excerpt for postmortem: ```
14:00:19 kernel_selector: preferred=quant_fast, selected=generic_kernel, reason=driver_mismatch
14:00:20 batcher: microbatch_jitter detected window_stddev=43ms -> increased tail latency
14:00:55 control-plane: feature-flag wavelet-route.use_stable_kernels=true applied
14:01:35 p95 latency back to baseline
```

alice_oncall: thanks all. I'll file the incident ticket and assign follow-ups. handing off monitoring to ben_runtime now. :white_check_mark:
